nodes.name: C2C API Gateway
nodes.description: Central entry point for all external requests, including various GUIs and external systems. Handles request routing and initial authentication.
responsibilities: Authenticate incoming requests
Route requests to appropriate backend modules/services
Provide a unified API facade

nodes.name: Incident Management BFF
nodes.description: Backend for Frontend specifically tailored for the Incident GUI, providing optimized data and operations for incident and lane closure management.
responsibilities: Serve incident and lane closure data to the Incident GUI
Process incident and lane closure creation, modification, and deletion requests from the GUI

nodes.name: Remote Control BFF
nodes.description: Backend for Frontend specifically tailored for the Remote Control GUI, managing device control commands and status requests.
responsibilities: Serve device status information to the Remote Control GUI
Process device control commands from the GUI
Display command/control status updates

nodes.name: Web Map BFF
nodes.description: Backend for Frontend specifically tailored for the Web Map Application, providing map data, traffic conditions, and interactive map features.
responsibilities: Generate map data for display on the Internet WWW server
Provide traffic condition overlays (e.g., speed color-coding)
Display incidents and device locations on the map
Handle map magnification and panning requests

nodes.name: Incident Management Use Cases
nodes.description: Encapsulates the application-specific business rules for managing incidents and lane closures, orchestrating interactions with domain and infrastructure layers.
responsibilities: Create, retrieve, update, and delete incident information
Create, retrieve, update, and delete lane closure information
Retrieve incidents for map display and tabular format

nodes.name: Device Management Use Cases
nodes.description: Manages the business logic for traffic device status retrieval and control command issuance.
responsibilities: Retrieve status information for various traffic devices
Process control commands for traffic devices
Provide command timeframe information
Retrieve device information for map display

nodes.name: Network Data Use Cases
nodes.description: Handles the business logic for managing roadway network, link, and node data.
responsibilities: Retrieve roadway network information
Retrieve link data (identifier, name, type)
Retrieve node information (identifier, name, type)

nodes.name: Map Generation Use Cases
nodes.description: Orchestrates the process of generating map data, applying symbology, and integrating various traffic data for graphical depiction.
responsibilities: Prepare map data for display (interstates, state highways)
Apply speed-based color coding to links
Integrate incident and device data onto the map
Manage map zoom and pan operations

nodes.name: Authentication Use Cases
nodes.description: Manages user authentication and authorization processes.
responsibilities: Validate user credentials (username, password)
Manage user sessions

nodes.name: Data Ingestion Use Cases
nodes.description: Orchestrates the reception, validation, and storage of traffic management data from various connected systems.
responsibilities: Receive and process TMDD data elements and message sets
Combine data from connected systems into a single data store
Support normal and test mode operations (including logging)

nodes.name: Traffic Domain Entities
nodes.description: Core business objects representing traffic management concepts such as roadway networks, links, nodes, incidents, lane closures, and various traffic devices.
responsibilities: Define structure and behavior of traffic-related data (e.g., Link, Node, Incident, Device)
Enforce core business rules related to traffic data integrity

nodes.name: User & Configuration Domain Entities
nodes.description: Core business objects for user credentials and system configuration parameters.
responsibilities: Define structure and behavior of User and Configuration data
Enforce business rules related to user authentication and system configuration

nodes.name: Domain Services
nodes.description: Encapsulates complex, cross-entity business rules and orchestrates interactions between domain entities that don't fit naturally into a single entity.
responsibilities: Implement complex traffic management business logic (e.g., device control validation)
Coordinate data aggregation and transformation for reporting/display

nodes.name: C2C Main Database
nodes.description: Primary data store for all core traffic management data, including network topology, incidents, lane closures, and device status/control information.
responsibilities: Persist roadway network, link, and node data
Persist incident and lane closure data
Persist traffic device status and control command data
Store TMDD data elements and message sets

nodes.name: User & Auth Database
nodes.description: Dedicated data store for user credentials and authentication-related information.
responsibilities: Persist user names and passwords
Store user authentication tokens/sessions

nodes.name: Configuration Database
nodes.description: Data store for system configuration parameters, including dynamic settings like speed values for map symbology.
responsibilities: Persist system configuration parameters
Store speed values for link color coding

nodes.name: Persistence Adapters
nodes.description: Implements the data storage interfaces defined by the Domain layer, translating domain objects to database-specific formats and vice-versa.
responsibilities: Translate domain entities to database records
Translate database records to domain entities
Perform CRUD operations on C2C Main, User & Auth, and Configuration databases

nodes.name: TMDD/DATEX/ASN Adapter
nodes.description: Handles communication with external systems using ITS standards like TMDD, DATEX/ASN, and TCP/IP.
responsibilities: Encode/decode TMDD message sets using DATEX/ASN
Manage TCP/IP communication for data transmission
Provide runtime library for DATEX/ASN

nodes.name: ESRI Map Adapter
nodes.description: Integrates with ESRI products (ARC IMS, Map Objects) to provide map generation and display capabilities.
responsibilities: Interface with ESRI ARC IMS for map image creation
Utilize ESRI Map Objects for GUI-based map rendering
Translate internal map data to ESRI-compatible formats

nodes.name: External System Connectors
nodes.description: Provides specific interfaces and protocols for connecting to various external traffic management systems and data sources.
responsibilities: Connect to TxDOT Traffic Management Centers (TMCs)
Connect to existing traffic management systems
Retrieve basemap data from NCTCOG GeoData warehouse

nodes.name: Logging & Monitoring Module
nodes.description: Provides system-wide logging capabilities, especially for activity tracking in test mode.
responsibilities: Log system activities and events
Support different logging levels (e.g., for normal vs. test mode)

nodes.name: Microsoft Windows NT Environment
nodes.description: The operating system and runtime environment where the C2CTest server application executes.
responsibilities: Provide operating system services
Host the C/C++ runtime environment

nodes.name: TxDOT Traffic Management Centers (TMCs)
nodes.description: External systems managed by TxDOT that exchange traffic management data with C2CTest.
responsibilities: Provide traffic data to C2CTest
Receive control commands/status from C2CTest

nodes.name: Existing Traffic Management Systems
nodes.description: Other external traffic management systems that C2CTest integrates with to collect and disseminate data.
responsibilities: Exchange traffic management data with C2CTest

nodes.name: NCTCOG GeoData Warehouse
nodes.description: External data source for basemap data used in the C2CTest system.
responsibilities: Provide basemap data (e.g., roadway networks) to C2CTest

nodes.name: ESRI ARC Internet Map Server (ARC IMS)
nodes.description: Commercial off-the-shelf product used by C2CTest for creating and serving map images.
responsibilities: Generate map images based on provided data

nodes.name: Internet WWW Server
nodes.description: An external web server responsible for hosting and displaying the C2CTest Web Map application.
responsibilities: Host the Web Map application
Serve map content to end-users

edges.payload_description: Incident and lane‑closure CRUD requests from Incident GUI
edges.justification: API Gateway authenticates and forwards incident‑related HTTP calls to the Incident Management BFF

edges.payload_description: Device status queries and control command submissions from Remote Control GUI
edges.justification: API Gateway routes authenticated remote‑control HTTP calls to the Remote Control BFF

edges.payload_description: Map view requests (zoom, pan, overlay toggles) from Web Map GUI
edges.justification: API Gateway forwards map‑related HTTP calls to the Web Map BFF

edges.payload_description: Incident/lane‑closure use‑case invocations (create, read, update, delete)
edges.justification: Incident BFF delegates business operations to the Incident Management Use Cases module

edges.payload_description: Device status retrieval, control command execution, and timeframe queries
edges.justification: Remote Control BFF invokes Device Management Use Cases for device‑centric operations

edges.payload_description: Map generation parameters (zoom level, pan direction, overlay selections)
edges.justification: Web Map BFF calls Map Generation Use Cases to assemble map data

edges.payload_description: Domain entities for incidents, lane closures, links, nodes
edges.justification: Incident use cases manipulate Traffic Domain Entities

edges.payload_description: Domain entities for traffic devices, status, and control parameters
edges.justification: Device use cases work with Traffic Domain Entities

edges.payload_description: Network, link, and node domain objects
edges.justification: Network Data Use Cases retrieve roadway network domain entities

edges.payload_description: Map‑specific domain objects (links with speed values, incident icons, device markers)
edges.justification: Map Generation Use Cases consume Traffic Domain Entities to build map layers

edges.payload_description: User credential verification and configuration retrieval requests
edges.justification: Authentication Use Cases operate on User & Configuration Domain Entities

edges.payload_description: Raw TMDD/DATEX/ASN messages received from external traffic systems
edges.justification: Data Ingestion Use Cases delegate encoding/decoding to the TMDD/DATEX/ASN Adapter

edges.payload_description: Encoded TMDD message sets exchanged with external traffic management systems
edges.justification: Adapter publishes TMDD data to the External System Connectors for transport

edges.payload_description: Bidirectional TMDD traffic data and control commands for TxDOT TMCs
edges.justification: External System Connectors relay TMDD messages to/from TxDOT Traffic Management Centers

edges.payload_description: Exchange of TMDD data with legacy traffic management systems
edges.justification: Connectors enable interoperability with existing traffic management systems

edges.payload_description: Requests for basemap raster/vector data from NCTCOG GeoData Warehouse
edges.justification: Connectors fetch basemap data needed for map generation

edges.payload_description: Map image generation requests (tiles, legends) to ESRI ARC IMS
edges.justification: ESRI Map Adapter forwards rendered map data to the ARC Internet Map Server

edges.payload_description: Prepared map data (layers, symbols) for ESRI Map Adapter
edges.justification: Web Map BFF hands off map payload to the ESRI Map Adapter

edges.payload_description: Persist new or updated incident and lane‑closure records
edges.justification: Incident Use Cases write incident data to the C2C Main Database via Persistence Adapters

edges.payload_description: Query incident and lane‑closure data for display in GUI tables
edges.justification: Incident Use Cases read stored incident data for presentation

edges.payload_description: Store device status updates and executed control commands
edges.justification: Device Management Use Cases persist device state and command logs

edges.payload_description: Retrieve current device status and command timeframe information
edges.justification: Device Use Cases read device data needed for GUI display

edges.payload_description: Read roadway network, link, and node records
edges.justification: Network Data Use Cases fetch network topology from the main database

edges.payload_description: Read speed‑value configuration for link color‑coding
edges.justification: Map Generation Use Cases need configuration data to apply speed‑based colors

edges.payload_description: Retrieve stored usernames, password hashes, and authentication tokens
edges.justification: Authentication Use Cases validate credentials against the User & Auth Database

edges.payload_description: Persist new session tokens after successful login
edges.justification: Authentication Use Cases store session information for subsequent requests

edges.payload_description: Authenticated internal service invocation
edges.justification: C2C API Gateway routes requests to Domain Services

edges.payload_description: INSERT/UPDATE domain entities and status
edges.justification: Incident Management BFF persists data to dedicated datastore C2C Main Database

edges.payload_description: INSERT/UPDATE domain entities and status
edges.justification: User & Configuration Domain Entities persists data to dedicated datastore Configuration Database

edges.payload_description: Authenticated internal service invocation
edges.justification: C2C API Gateway routes requests to Logging & Monitoring Module

edges.payload_description: External incoming messages and telemetry
edges.justification: External system Microsoft Windows NT Environment exchanges data with C2C API Gateway

edges.payload_description: External incoming messages and telemetry
edges.justification: External system Internet WWW Server exchanges data with C2C API Gateway
